newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's MGTS names Salomon to lead bond. [CORRECTED 15:44 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Russia's MGTS names Salomon to lead bond. [CORRECTED 15:44 GMT]

text.p: Moscow telephone company MGTS 0#MGTS.RUO has selected U.S. investment bank Salomon Bros to lead a planned offering of its bonds on the Euromarkets, MGTS's financial adviser Guta-Invest said on Friday.
Salomon won a tender called in July to lead a consortium to place the issue for MGTS (AO Moskovskaya Gorodskaya Telefonnaya Set), Guta-Invest board member Sergei Drozzhin told Reuters.
(Corrects title and first name of Drozzhin)
"It is now necessary for MGTS, Salomon and Guta-Invest to agree on the parameters of the issue," Drozzhin said.
MGTS will also conduct a 1,000-for-one share split, Drozzhin said.
Its shares last traded on October 21 at $580, an exceptionally high figure for a single share in Moscow.

Russian state telecoms holding company AO Svyazinvest holds 46.7 percent of MGTS. The Moscow Committee for Science and Technology holds 33 percent, Bank of Bermuda 3.37 percent, GUTA-Invest 1.01 percent, CS First Boston 1.23 percent and Burlington Investments Ltd 1.28 percent.
